title_short: Kevin Holmes · I Was That Kid
headline: A TV anchor was the kid teased for his shoes. Now he hands new shoes to kids.
story: Kevin Holmes is the evening anchor at KARE 11 in Minneapolis and a Soles4Souls partner. He grew up on the South Side of Chicago, in the Michael Jordan era, when sneakers were everything. His family got shoes at Payless. He got teased. He fought back and got suspended.

Then he got his first new pair and felt invincible. That is why he is here: 500 kids in the Twin Cities get new shoes today. His last line is the whole idea: shoes last a year, but knowing someone cares lasts a lifetime. The teasing is the start, not the mood. The video ends warm and proud.
